prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A mid-century modern living room scene, centered on a sleek wooden credenza against a rich, dark wood-paneled wall. On the credenza sits a large flat-screen television displaying a close-up of a hand holding a harmonica, the background softly blurred with a shallow depth of field. To the right of the TV, a small studio monitor speaker and two digital screens are arranged: one shows a close-up of hands playing piano keys, the other reflects a similar musical moment, both with cool, natural lighting and crisp detail. The composition is symmetrical and balanced, with a woven chair featuring a geometric pattern partially visible on the left, and a large speaker with visible drivers on the right. The color palette is warm and inviting, dominated by deep browns, soft golds, and subtle blue accents from the screens. The lighting is soft and diffused, evoking a cozy, creative atmosphere. The overall style is cinematic and modern, with a focus on musical creativity and a harmonious blend of analog and digital elements.
